bodies: We cold-steep our Guatemalan single origin for 18 hours, then kegged it the same morning. The first 300 growlers ship Friday. Reserve yours before the roast sells out.
Store-bought cold brew is roasted months before you drink it. Ours was roasted on Tuesday. Taste the difference, or your money back.
Zero sugar. Zero additives. One origin. Northwind Cold Brew is now in 32 oz growlers for home fridges and 5 L boxes for the office.
Every growler is traceable to the farm lot on the label. Scan the code, meet the grower, see the harvest date. That is what fresh actually means.
The office fridge deserves better than vending-machine cans. Northwind Cold Brew boxes pour 20 cups and stay fresh for 14 days once opened.
